description: A terminal window is open in the Muncie HEC-RAS project directory. The HEC-RAS 6.6 Linux compute engines are installed and available in the system PATH. The directory contains the Muncie flood model project files needed for a 2D unsteady flow simulation. Your task is to identify the correct HEC-RAS solver executable and run the unsteady flow simulation for this project. Examine the available project files and HEC-RAS executables to determine the appropriate command and arguments. The simulation models a flood event on the White River and should complete within a few minutes. After the simulation finishes successfully, rename the output HDF5 file from its temporary name to Muncie.p04.hdf.
